note: Share of a small-town establishment's receipts paid by buyers outside the town (nonresident consumers, outside businesses, government programs, insurers, mortgage-funded buyers). Wholesale is omitted: its sales to local firms are already recorded routes. Research: OPUS-CORE helper, Oct 12, 2026. Each firm's outside sales are its industry's share of its receipts; nothing tops a firm up to its projection.

farm.citation: USDA NASS 2017 Census of Agriculture: direct-to-consumer sales about $2.8B of $388.5B market value; https://www.nass.usda.gov/Publications/AgCensus/2017/

quarry.citation: No class-of-customer table for mining (2017 Economic Census).
quarry.estimatedFrom: Buyers are contractors, ready-mix plants and state transportation departments, none of them town households.

construction.citation: U.S. Census Bureau, Value of Construction Put in Place 2017: private nonresidential plus public 58% of $1,231B; https://www.census.gov/construction/c30/pdf/ototal.pdf

manufacturing.citation: Manufacturing is outside the 2017 Economic Census class-of-customer table.
manufacturing.estimatedFrom: Shipments go to other firms and distant markets; a small-town plant sells almost nothing to its own residents.

trucking.citation: Truck transportation is outside the 2017 Economic Census class-of-customer table.
trucking.estimatedFrom: Freight is billed to shippers, which are businesses, mostly elsewhere.

inn.citation: U.S. Census Bureau, 2017 Economic Census, class of customer (EC1700CLCUST), NAICS 7211: businesses 29.9%, government 4.1%, households 66% (travelers, nonresident by definition); https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/economic-census/data/2017/sector00/EC1700CLCUST.zip

care-home.citation: U.S. Census Bureau, 2017 Economic Census, type of payer (EC1762TYPEPAYER), NAICS 6231: Medicaid 46.6%, Medicare 28.1%, private insurance 9.4%, other government 1.6%, out-of-pocket 8.5%; https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/economic-census/data/2017/sector62/EC1762TYPEPAYER.zip

insurance.citation: U.S. Census Bureau, 2017 Economic Census, product lines (EC1700NAPCSINDPRD), NAICS 524210: 95.9% brokerage and agency commissions paid by carriers; https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/economic-census/data/2017/sector00/EC1700NAPCSINDPRD.zip

realty.citation: U.S. Census Bureau, 2017 Economic Census, product lines (EC1700NAPCSINDPRD), NAICS 531210: residential sales 66.2%, nonresidential 17.8%, residential rental 6.4%.
realty.estimatedFrom: Commissions come out of closing proceeds, mostly mortgage-financed and often from buyers moving in; counted as outside money.

private-school.citation: No revenue-mix table for K-12 private schools in the 2017 Economic Census.
private-school.estimatedFrom: Tuition is mostly local families; outside money is vouchers, education savings accounts, federal Title services and outside donors.

restaurant.citation: U.S. Census Bureau, 2017 Economic Census, class of customer (EC1700CLCUST), NAICS 7225: business expense accounts 8.0% + government 1.6% (sourced floor 9.6%).
restaurant.estimatedFrom: The rest is travelers and commuters, which the Census table can't separate; to be checked against BEA's Travel and Tourism Satellite Account.

building-services.citation: U.S. Census Bureau, 2017 Economic Census, class of customer (EC1700CLCUST), NAICS 56172 janitorial: businesses 73%, government 7.3%, nonprofits 4.8%, households 14.9%.

information.citation: U.S. Census Bureau, 2017 Economic Census, class of customer (EC1700CLCUST), NAICS 517: residential 65.6%, all others 34.4%.

personal-care.citation: Personal care is outside the 2017 Economic Census class-of-customer table; NAICS 812111 is 95% hair-care services.
personal-care.estimatedFrom: Nearly all buyers are households; outside money is customers from the surrounding rural area.

professional.citation: U.S. Census Bureau, 2017 Economic Census, product lines (EC1700NAPCSINDPRD): tax preparation 541213 individuals 79%; accounting 541211 individuals 13.3%; legal 5411 business law 40.1%.
professional.estimatedFrom: Midpoint across tax, accounting and legal offices.

retail.citation: U.S. Census Bureau, 2017 Economic Census, class of customer (EC1700CLCUST), NAICS 44-45: households 89%, business and government 11% (sourced floor).
retail.estimatedFrom: The rest is shoppers from the surrounding trade area; building materials (444) is 46.6% outside, grocery (445) 1.4%.

repair.citation: U.S. Census Bureau, 2017 Economic Census, product lines (EC1700NAPCSINDPRD), NAICS 811111: heavy-truck and bus repair 16.2% (fleets), body repair 7.9% (often insurers).
repair.estimatedFrom: Fleet and insurer payments plus customers passing through.

recreation.citation: Recreation is outside the 2017 Economic Census class-of-customer table; NAICS 713950 is bowling 56.7%, food and alcohol 32%.
recreation.estimatedFrom: Customers are local households; outside money is visitors and corporate events.
